profit_quality.assessment: The reported 2024 net profit of HK$6.478m is not a clean operating-business cash profit because bank interest income of HK$6.981m is larger than operating profit. After stripping excess cash, the operating business should be valued on a much lower cash earnings base. Three-year cash conversion is mixed: 2022 benefited from working-capital release, 2023 was strong, and 2024 free cash flow after capex was slightly negative.
adjustments: Excluded excess-cash interest income from the operating-business profit base.
Treated listed equity FVTPL gain and life-policy return as non-operating or detachable-asset related.
Used a conservative HK$5.0m pre-haircut sustainable distributable cash profit instead of reported net profit or the best cash-flow year.
Applied a 0.50 cash-profit haircut because 2024 revenue and margin declined, 2024 operating cash flow was below capital expenditure, and operating profit was thin after removing cash interest.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2022/2023/2024 operating cash flow was HK$42.880m/HK$18.385m/HK$6.878m; capex was HK$1.514m/HK$3.607m/HK$7.310m. The best year was driven by receivable collection and is not used as the main denominator.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Recent operating profit after excluding cash interest is low, free cash flow was weak in 2024, and the business is exposed to customer/geography shifts.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Accounting profit can convert to cash in some years, but cash flow is materially affected by receivable swings.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not disclosed; median 2022-2024 capex of HK$3.607m is used as a conservative proxy.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Customer credit terms of 30-120 days and 2022 receivable release show working-capital swings are material; no separate normal reinvestment number can be proven.
